name: aeomirror
description: AEOMirror monorepo — FastAPI backend + Vite/React frontend. One-command local dev.

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && { test -x .venv/bin/python || { echo '[dev:backend] Backend venv missing. Run: npm run setup:backend' >&2; exit 1; }; } && exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && { test -x .venv/bin/python || { echo '[test:backend] Backend venv missing. Run: npm run setup:backend' >&2; exit 1; }; } && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
